*Someone has been taking the quarry bounties off the gate board before Thurstan gets there. He wants to beat them to the Spoil Heaps, and asks Roland to judge who did more.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 50 [Rubble Golem](../monsters/rubble_golem.md) in [The Spoil Heaps](../maps/spoil_heaps.md)
